description: This file defines Pydantic data models representing schemas related to restaurants, menus, and menu items within a food delivery backend system. It includes base classes, creation/update variants, and output models, encapsulating restaurant and menu properties, with configurations for ORM compatibility.

classes.name: RestaurantBase
classes.description: Base schema for restaurant details, including name, description, contact info, address, location, and active status.

classes.name: RestaurantCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a restaurant, extending RestaurantBase with an optional owner_user_id.

classes.name: RestaurantUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating restaurant details, with all fields optional.

classes.name: RestaurantOut
classes.description: Schema for output representation of a restaurant, including id and owner_user_id, with configuration for ORM attribute mapping.

classes.name: MenuBase
classes.description: Base schema for menu details, including name, description, and active status.

classes.name: MenuCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a menu, extending MenuBase with restaurant_id.

classes.name: MenuUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating menu details, with all fields optional.

classes.name: MenuOut
classes.description: Schema for output representation of a menu, including id and restaurant_id, with ORM configuration.

classes.name: MenuItemBase
classes.description: Base schema for menu item details, including name, description, price, currency, image URL, and availability.

classes.name: MenuItemCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a menu item, extending MenuItemBase with menu_id.

classes.name: MenuItemUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating menu item details, with all fields optional.

classes.name: MenuItemOut
classes.description: Schema for output representation of a menu item, including id, menu_id, and restaurant_id, with ORM configuration.
